resources.string: Parent lock: Android asks to turn this off before ScrollNah can be uninstalled. ScrollNah can\'t control anything else on this phone.

Lets ScrollNah spot Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and sites like youtube.com, so it can count those minutes and how many Reels and Shorts you scroll, and remind you at your limit (pressing Back once to leave Reels or Shorts). It only checks which screen is open in those apps, when their videos scroll, and your browser\'s address bar. It never reads messages, passwords or other apps. Only minutes and the count are saved, on this phone.
